attr.title: Sonic.EXE
attr.desc: Experience the horror of Sonic.EXE in this handheld Linux port.
attr.inst:
- Install the port via PortMaster.
- Obtain a copy of the original SONIC.EXE game file.
- Copy SONIC.EXE into the sonicexe folder.
- Launch Sonic.EXE. The game data will be extracted automatically on first launch.
- Enjoy!
